senses.gloss:
m. (-टः)
1 A fort, a strong hold.
2 A shed, a hut.
3 Crookedness, curvature.

m. (-ट्टः-ट्टं)
A fort, a castle, a strong hold.
E.
कुट्ट to cut or divide, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Who or what curves or bends.
m. (-कः)
A thatcher, a builder of huts, &c.
E.
कुट to be crooked, ण्वुल aff.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The hollow of a tree.
f. (-री)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 A naked woman: see कोटवी.
E.
कोट and र, from रा to get, to possess, with the affix ड.

m. (-रः)
1 A well.
2 The stairs of a pond.
3 A fortified town, a strong hold.
4 A libertine.
E.
कोट्ट a fort, &c. ऋ to go, affix अप्.

n. (-णं)
A wood in which there are hollow trees.
E.
कोटर the hollow of a tree, and वन a wood; by special rules, the final vowel of the first word is made long, and न in the second is changed to ण.

f. (-वी)
1 A naked woman.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
कोट crookedness, and वा to get or receive, क and ङीष् affixes; also कोट्टवी, and कोटरी.

f. (-वी)
1 A naked woman.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
3 The mother of Vāṇa, an asura: see कोटवी.

f. (-टिः)
1 The edge or point of a sword.
2 The end of a bow.
3 A number, a Krore or ten millions.
4 Eminence, excellence.
5 The upright side of a triangle.
6 The complement of an are to 90°.
7 A plant, Piring or Asparac, (Medicago esculenta.)
E.
कुट to be crooked, and इण् Uṇādi affix; also कोटी.

f. (-टी)
1 The edge or point of a sword.
2 A medicinal plant, (Medicago esculenta.)
3 A Krore, &c.: see कोटि.

m. (-कः)
An insect., coccinella of various kinds; this is most usually read कोटिर.

m. (-जित्)
A name of the poet KĀLIDĀSA.
E.
केटि a crore, (of competitors,) and जित् conqueror.

f. (-ज्या)
The cosine of an angle, in a right angled triangle.
E.
कोटि, and ज्या a sine.

m. (-त्रः)
A rudder or large oar used as one.
E.
कोटि an edge, and पात्र a plank.

m. (-रः)
1 An ichneumon, (Viverra ichneumon.)
2 An insect, coccinella of various kinds: see इन्द्रगोप.
3 A name of INDRA.
E.
कोटि excellence, and र what possesses.

m. (-रः)
1 Long entangled hair.
2 A crest, a diadem.
E.
कुट to be crooked, इरन् affix and the radical vowel converted.

n. (-र्षं)
The name of a city, Vāṇapura or Devikote, on the Koromandel coast.
f. (-र्षा)
A plant used as a medicinal vegetable, (Medicago esculenta): see पिडिङ्ग.
E.
कोटि excellence, वर्ष what diffuses.

n. (-र्षं)
A name of Vāṇapura.
f. (-र्षा)
Piring, a plant: see कोटिवर्ष.

m. (-शः)
A harrow.
E.
कोटि an edge, शो to cut or pare, क aff.

m. (-शः)
A harrow: see कोटिश.

ind.
In multitudes, by millions.
E.
कोटि, and शसि aff.

n. (-रं)
Vanapur or Devicotta.
E.
कोट्टवी the mother of Vāṇa, and पुर a city.
